disposition_reason: Table 1 prints mean ± SD (n=3) concentrations of nine metals in ten market fruits from Umuahia.

study.design: market survey of ten fruits with daily intake, target hazard quotient and cancer risk
study.market: Ubani market, Umuahia, Abia State, Nigeria
study.method: washed, oven dried 100 °C 48 h, HNO3/HClO4 (5:1) digestion, AAS (Thermo AA 303), triplicates
study.qa: calibration with Merck single-element standards; no CRM or recovery reported

regulatory_or_exposure.what: 'permissible limits' printed in Table 1 (source not given)

unresolved: The text says S. melongena, J. regia, A. muricata, P. kschum and D. tripetala had no detectable cobalt, and the abstract says cobalt was absent in C. lanatus and J. regia, but Table 1 prints cobalt values for several of these; the nickel column matches the text's list, so the text likely means nickel. Table values recorded.
Table footnote says mean ± SD, methods say standard errors.
The 'permissible limits' in Table 1 (for example Cd 0.001 ppm, Cu 0.010 ppm) do not match Codex or WHO values and their source is not given.
Number of fruit units purchased and collection dates not reported.
DIM, THQ and cancer-risk tables (Tables 2-5) are derived, not recorded.
